== Notes ==
* This skill only increases the base adrenaline from hitting with an attack, not any other attack effects that grant adrenaline (such as [[Knee Cutter]] and [[Steelfang Slash]]).
* This skill exactly requires 80 units of adrenaline to be fully charged, so 3 strikes and 5 units.
* Can be maintained even with rank 0 in Strength as long as the user continuously hits a [[foe]] successfully (i.e. not have all attacks be [[block]]ed, [[miss]], be [[Line of sight|obstructed]], etc.) while this stance is active.
* Due to [[effect stacking]], this stance will not stack with other skills which increase adrenaline gain, such as [["For Great Justice!"]].
